note: Wooded loess-hills area south of St. Joseph above the Missouri River valley, with trails to bluff-top views. The mapped primitive camping area is a grassy clearing beside small gravel parking lot C on Lewis School Road, the gravel road through the middle of the area. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites'/'Individual Campsites'; the map shows one Primitive Camping area at lot C on Lewis School Road (the stored pin); free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. A second GIS point 2.5 km north sits on a grass service lane the map doesn't mark - not counted. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Designated Camping Sites' and 'Individual Campsites'. The 12/4/2018 map shows ONE Primitive Camping symbol, beside parking lot C on Lewis School SW (gravel road through the area from Bethel SW/Dreier SW). GIS camping point 112 (39.62061,-94.94280 = stored pin) is in a mowed grassy clearing ~30 m from lot 1374 (39.62033,-94.94269), a small gravel lot just east of the gravel road. A 23-ft rig fits the lot/clearing; no ford, no posted limit.

SECOND GIS POINT (not counted): layer 27 point 326 (39.64202,-94.93432), 2.5 km NNE, is at the end of a mowed grass lane (service road) in the north parcel ~550 m NW of the Forest Nature Trail lot E; the map shows no camping there and imagery shows no gravel or lot - not a drive-in spot for a 23-ft rig on what is visible. Not a split candidate.
PIN: stored 39.62061,-94.94280 = GIS point 112 at lot C - fine.
